title: Fix off-by-one errors reported as a bug
prompt: A user reports two bugs in the result pager of this project. (1) With exactly 40 results and 20 per page, the pager says there are 3 pages and the third one is empty. (2) The caption on page 2 says "Showing 20-40 of 45" but it should say "Showing 21-40 of 45". Find and fix the cause in src/paginate.mjs, and add a test for each so they cannot come back.
